source: lab (captured; background replaced: 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' watermark, black background)

camera.motion: static (phase correlation between consecutive frames |shift| <= 0.2 px on every frame)
camera.view: oblique, looking down onto a table top from above/front; the ball rolls from the far (back) edge toward the camera (front edge), i.e. mostly in depth, image direction down and slightly left

objects.name: ball
objects.description: small white ball (looks like a ping-pong ball); the only moving object
objects.reference_point: visible centre (mask centroid cx,cy; alternative cx_box,cy_box)

apparent_diameter_px.note: width of bbox (x1-x0+1); horizontal extent is the most reliable size measure; grows as ball approaches camera

objects.name: table_top
objects.description: light-brown wooden rectangular table top (slab ~10-12 px thick at the front edge), static
objects.note: long axis runs left-right (back and front edges); ball rolls across the short axis (back edge -> front edge). Perspective: front edge longer than back edge (closer). Table may be tilted (ball accelerates from rest) - not measurable from pixels alone.

objects.name: table_leg
objects.description: single grey/metal post under the table top, right of centre, partly visible below the front edge

events.note: first displacement between frame 11 and 12 (4 px); motion start within (0.458, 0.5] s

events.note: step 35->36 is ~12 px vs ~5-6 px neighbours

events.event: ball reaches front edge / leaves table top
events.note: frame 45 last frame fully on top surface; 46 at the edge; 47-48 below the edge, falling, motion-blurred

events.event: ball falling below table front edge
